Name: Dottore - NPC (Genshin Impact)
Author: CometBoba
Description:
[center]﻿[/center][left]Notes[/left][left][/left][left](23th March, 2024): Hello everyone! It seems like the mod is not working properly after the new 1.6 update. Update for the mod might take a while as I cannot work on it at the moment. I'm not sure if I'm even able to fix it, but I will try working on it when I'm free![/left][left][/left][left]
﻿﻿﻿[img]https://i.postimg.cc/1tcMWkyw/dotto2.png[/img]

[b][i]Il Dottore, a character from Genshin Impact by HoYoVerse[/i][/b]

﻿[size=1]The Second of the Fatui Harbinger — [i]The Doctor[/i]. Just his title alone sends shivers down many's spine. He's known for the... experiments he has conducted. One crazy
[/size][size=1]scientist, indeed. But despite all the things he has done, you still choose to court him... Well, lucky you, he is marriageable[/size].

[size=2]This mod features:[/size]
[size=1]- New portraits[/size]
[size=1]- New sprites[/size]
[size=1]- He has his own house (located above the bus stop. As for the other verion that's compatible with other mods, it's in the mountains)[/size]
[size=1]- He has his own heart events
[/size]- [size=1]He has his own schedule [/size]

· · ─────── ·[url=https://emojipedia.org/syringe]💉[/url]· ─────── · ·

Requirements:
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI
[/url]- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher﻿
[/url]- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6358]Custom Fixed Dialogue﻿[/url]﻿

Installation:
- Install the latest version of SMAPI and Content Patcher
- Download the mod and unzip file
- Place it in your Mods folder
- Run the game with SMAPI

· · ─────── ·[url=https://emojipedia.org/syringe]💉[/url]· ─────── · ·

If you want to stalk him. There's a "README.txt" file within "[CP] Dottore NPC" 

Inside includes his loves and hates, his schedule and how to trigger his heart events

· · ─────── ·[url=https://emojipedia.org/syringe]💉[/url]· ─────── · ·

Note: This is my first time creating a mod so bugs are prone to exist. If you find any, please tell me! I can't guarantee that I'll know how to fix them, but I'll try!
And of course, this mod isn't perfect and do expect some flaws and mistakes. I made this just for fun (and to feed myself)

!Please take note that how Dottore acts and talks may not be canonically accurate!

I hope you guys enjoy this mod and have a happy married life with little meow meow :)

Downloads.Description: This version is compatible with RE3 and RSV (possibily SVE as well). Entrance to Dottore's house can be changed (to bus stop or mountains) to be compatible with whichever enxtention mod you're using in content.json. Thank you PumpkingP13 for making this!
